bridge_2026.json.notes: the bridge match rate, scoped to the twenty study aerodromes -- `events_gt.bridge_report` applies the same airport filter the milestones get, and carries the network-wide figure alongside it under `network` as context. Runs first and alone because it is the ceiling on every coverage figure downstream: a milestone that cannot be reached is indistinguishable from one that was missed unless this number is known -- and a ceiling computed over a different population than the coverage caps nothing.

per_airport_2026.csv.notes: Per-aerodrome and per-detector scoring of the same V07_shipped re-run, for Task 7 of the aobt-aibt-from-pbf plan. Confirms the block-time lift is concentrated at EDDS (+40.9pp AOBT, +22.4pp AIBT) with small moves elsewhere (LKPR, UGKO) and no material change at most of the fifteen aerodromes that already carried stand geometry, and pins the off-block/on-block bias (~+720s / ~-300s, uniform across aerodromes) that neither the gate fix nor the geometry touches. Actual invocation used --executors 10 --driver-memory 16g, not the --executors 12 the entrypoint's Job default records.
